main.description: A short pitch with buttons. The first button is the main one.

text.description: A few lines under the heading.

buttons.description: In display order. Readers skip kinds they do not know.

email.description: Opens an email to a published address.

address.description: An email address. Readers check that it is a single plain address before building a mailto link from it.

uri.description: An http or https URL. Readers ignore any other scheme.

preset.description: What the button is for; readers word it in the viewer's language. Absent or unknown means readers show the label.

label.description: Button text, used when the preset is absent or unknown. Without a label, readers show the link's site name.
